title: ResearchWorkspaceBundleV1SharedDefinitions
description: Shared definitions ($defs) for the ResearchWorkspaceBundleV1 schema suite. These definitions are referenced by every per-document schema via $ref. This document is NOT a standalone document schema; it is a vocabulary module.

bundle_version.description: Bundle contract version. Fixed to '1.0' for the V1 contract.

run_status.description: Lifecycle status of a research run.

claim_status.description: Validation outcome for a synthesized claim.

review_decision_type.description: Decision recorded by a human reviewer at a review gate.

fault_type.description: Class of failure recorded against an adapter or run step.

target_type.description: The kind of artifact a validation check targets.

decision_type.description: Classifier for a policy decision (free-form but required).

source_id.description: Opaque identifier for a retrieved source record.

evidence_id.description: Opaque identifier for an extracted evidence record.

claim_id.description: Opaque identifier for a synthesized claim.

citation_id.description: Opaque identifier for a formatted citation record.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 digest (64 hex characters).

path.description: Relative path of the artifact within the bundle.

file_hash.description: A file path paired with its SHA-256 digest.

origin_api.description: Adapter / API that produced the source (e.g. 'arxiv', 'semantic_scholar').

query_used.description: The query (or query identifier) that retrieved this source.

doi.description: Digital Object Identifier for the source, if available.

abstract.description: Abstract or summary text, if available.

artifact_ref.description: Artifact identity binding the source to the exact ingested content: 'ingested:<source_id>:<source_hash>' (H1.3).

source_record.description: A retrieved and ingested source record.

source_ids.description: Source records this evidence was extracted from.

extracted_text.description: Verbatim or paraphrased text drawn from the source(s).

evidence_record.description: An evidence fragment extracted from one or more sources.

marker_id.description: Opaque identifier for this uncertainty marker.

affected_claim_ids.description: Claims that this uncertainty pertains to.

uncertainty_marker.description: A recorded uncertainty marker associated with one or more claims.

validation_id.description: Opaque identifier for this validation result.

target_id.description: Identifier of the target artifact (source/evidence/claim/citation id).

check_name.description: Name of the validation check that was executed.

validation_result.description: Result of a single automated validation check against a target artifact.

supporting_evidence_ids.description: Evidence records that support this claim.

contradicting_evidence_ids.description: Evidence records that contradict this claim.

uncertainty_markers.description: Uncertainty markers attached to this claim.

validation_results.description: Validation results produced for this claim.

claim_record.description: A synthesized research claim with provenance, status, and validation history.

evidence_ids.description: Evidence records rendered through this citation.

citation_record.description: A formatted citation record linking a source to its evidence.

decision_id.description: Opaque identifier for this policy decision.

decider_identity.description: Identity of the decider (model id, human reviewer, or policy id).

policy_decision.description: A governance / policy decision recorded during the run (e.g. memory-write gate).

review_id.description: Opaque identifier for this review decision.

run_id.description: Identifier of the run this review decision pertains to.

review_decision.description: A human review decision recorded at a review gate.

failure_id.description: Opaque identifier for this failure record.

adapter_name.description: Name of the adapter or step that failed.

dispatch_occurred.description: Whether the failure happened after a tool/adapter dispatch (vs. before).

evidence_unavailable.description: Whether the failure left evidence unavailable for downstream synthesis.

failure_record.description: A recorded failure affecting one or more claims.
